evidence_gaps.evidence: Written rights/PII/copyright/transform/annotation/third-party rater scope and owner legal authorization
evidence_gaps.decision_change: If unattainable, keep empirical HOLD or consider a lawfully distinct source; if attested, enable only separately approved scoped feasibility inspection

evidence_gaps.evidence: Candidate sampling frame fixed prospectively; typed entity/location/time, authority, bounded time closure, witness/negation/exclusivity; all candidate/eligible/reject/abstain denominators and reasons, nonzero coverage with prereg threshold
evidence_gaps.decision_change: Construct feasible with honest coverage -> measurement remains candidate; systemic insufficiency -> HOLD/SIMPLIFY/PIVOT under new Q4, not post-hoc filtering

evidence_gaps.evidence: All label-changing material support/refutation/exclusivity facts preserved in both model-effective and rater-effective payloads after renderer/tokenizer/window/truncation; separate hidden key/oracle custody; exact byte provenance
evidence_gaps.decision_change: Parity established -> model-vs-rater agreement interpretable; parity violation -> item REJECT and measurement admission HOLD, not UNKNOWN

evidence_gaps.evidence: Independent source-grounded hidden gold derivation, blind same-task calibration and disagreements/adjudication, no shared ontology error, correct custody and permitted rater use
evidence_gaps.decision_change: Validated gold -> semantic adherence distinguishable from evaluator failure; shared error -> benchmark HOLD

evidence_gaps.evidence: Question/endpoint, unit and n with uncertainty/power; candidate/eligible/reject/abstain coverage; exact REJECT precedence preserving all reasons; threshold, STOP, budget and owner role frozen before outcomes
evidence_gaps.decision_change: GO/HOLD/STOP becomes auditable under frozen decision threshold; unknown costs cannot justify quantitative promise

evidence_gaps.evidence: Prospectively matched/group-disjoint fact-only vs cue-only contrasts with balanced lexical/position/length and prereg AD-06, only if causal shortcut attribution is desired
evidence_gaps.hard_veto: E3 M3 F-M04 for causal claims ONLY
evidence_gaps.decision_change: Distinguish genuine fact sensitivity from cue shortcut; without contrast avoid causal claim
